about_the_game:
Attention! Identical packages can not be activated on the same account twice!
Attention! Identical ships from different purchased bundles are not compensated!

This pack includes

  • Improved version of the Jericho rank 13 frigate “Palom”
  • “Torch” launcher
  • “Pulsating shield” modifier

Additionally, the pilot receives:
  • Permanent credit earnings bonus +10%
  • Unique portrait “Hammer London”
  • Special decor “Kylo”
  • Paint “Breach”
  • Stickers “DJ Summertime” and “Dyson Hemisphere”

Additionally, the pilot receives the modules:
  • Boarding charger
  • Pulsar
  • Energy converter
  • Multiphase shield adapter
  • Shared cooler
  • Catalyst injector
  • Multiphase generator
  • Acceleration coils
  • “Conformist” booster
  • Auxiliary shield projector
  • Crystal plates
  • Gun adapter

Special bonus for everyone who buys the bundle — Premium license for 90 days!

Guard ships are designed to protect their team from enemy missiles, as well as enhance the defences of allied ships. Guard ships feature strong defences and an enhanced Phase Shield.

Frigate ‘Palom’ has long been considered one of the best, reliable, and most importantly affordable Jericho ships. The ability to withstand heavy loads and its extended infrared scanner functions made it the best choice for mercenaries.

The second life of the ship started with the invasion. When pilots were required to patrol residential colonies, miners and farmers, teachers and builders, many of whom did not have experience with flight equipment volunteered. Then ‘Palom’ once again proved to be a reliable, easy to learn craft and became the basis of the militia fleet. On some planets that survived Alien attacks, decommissioned Paloms stand on central squares as monuments to heroes.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 512 MB, NVidia / AMD Radeon / Intel (HD 3000, HD 4000) with support for Pixel Shader 3.0 (AMD Radeon X1000 not supported)
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection

  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10
  • Processor: 2.3 GHz, Intel Core 2 Duo / 2.5 GHz, AMD A6-9220
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Video Card: 1024 MB, NVidia GeForce 650 / AMD Radeon HD 5750
  • Hard Disk Space: 8.5 GB
  • Additional: Broadband Internet connection
